test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programmes was launched during Union Budget 2020-21 for the nutrition of children and pregnant women?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poshan Abhiyaan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union finance minister Nirmala sitharaman announced the plan to merge the **existing Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP) and the Poshan Abhiyan to strengthen nutritional content, delivery, outreach, and outcome during her Budget 2021-22 speech on February 1, 2021.**
 
• The New scheme would now be called** Mission Poshan 2.0.**
 
• However, the budget document also reveals that the budget estimate on nutrition has gone down to Rs. 2700 crore in 2021-22, from Rs. 3700 crores in 2020-21.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poshan Abhiyan:**

 
 
• The government has approved the Centrally Sponsored Scheme '**Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman (PM POSHAN)** for providing one hot cooked meal in Government and Government-aided schools from 2021-22 to 2025-26. 
 
• This scheme is being implemented by the **Ministry of Education**.
 
• The tagline of Poshan Abhiyaan is ***Sahi Poshan Desh Roshan.***
 
• The program aims to provide adequate **nutrition to infants, pregnant ladies, and lactating mothers.**
